title: Finalize validates only the change it archives
description: Finalize validates only the change it archives
acceptance_criteria: One finalize spawns no more Git processes when more archived changes exist; every refusal finalize issues for the change it archives is unchanged; change audit --strict still names a hidden workflow-version downgrade in another archive; a Raven-sized finalize finishes in seconds.

answers.constraints: change.3md: refusing gates install no memo and stay live, and only passing verdicts are reused; REQ-change-119 and REQ-change-121 read-cache and finalize-memo rules stay as they are; REQ-change-audit-project-001 keeps the default audit active-only; REQ-change-049 keeps the ordinal-collision check at approve and audit; never weaken a gate for the change being finalized.
